items.title: Trump rejects Iran deal to reopen Strait of Hormuz in seven days
items.description: Iran's foreign minister acknowledges Trump's comments, but adds that Tehran is waiting for the "definitive views" of mediators.

items.title: Pope praises young people's 'energy and commitment' at huge open-air Mass in Paris
items.description: Around 700,000 people gathered in central Paris to hear the Catholic leader speak and offer prayer.

items.title: British national among six dead in building explosion close to Acropolis in Athens
items.description: Four Americans and a Greek national are among those killed in a suspected gas explosion, officials said.

items.title: German town bans 'stumbling stone' memorials to Nazi victims
items.description: Germany's education minister has branded the ban on the small brass memorial plaques a "scandal".

items.title: Nor'easter brings flooding as New York and New Jersey declare emergency
items.description: Tens of millions of people from Maine to Virginia are in the path of the powerful storm.

items.title: Republic of Ireland to wear black armbands for Israel game
items.description: Republic of Ireland players intend to wear black armbands "in recognition of all lives lost in the [Gaza] conflict" for match against Israel.

items.title: Mother of woman found hanging in tree shocked as police say body was staged
items.description: Christy Spivey tells the BBC she only has more questions now police think Tasia Fortune's body was put in the tree after her death.

items.title: Bangkok roads submerged as flood disaster declared
items.description: An emergency has been declared across the capital of Thailand as days of heavy rain leave the city inundated.

items.title: Security lapses at Utah campus where Charlie Kirk was killed, review says
items.description: The indpendent report also says Kirk's aides insisted he speak outdoors, overriding concerns from campus officials.

items.title: Brazil's Lula bans online gambling ahead of presidential election
items.description: Lula, who is currently in a tight presidential race against Flávio Bolsonaro, said the industry was a "cancer" that he must "remove".

items.title: Tenth woman's body found as South Africa police probe killings
items.description: The deaths have sparked a national outcry about the scale of violence against women in the country.

items.title: White House bars CNN from travelling with Trump on Air Force One
items.description: CNN was scheduled to fly with US President Donald Trump for his trip to Tennessee on Saturday.
